planned_steps: Check and verify authorized full client source and redistribution rights
Select an empty destination and verify sufficient disk space
Download to a separate staging folder with integrity verification
Safely extract an authenticated client archive and confirm Wow.exe 3.3.5a build 12340
Fetch Naxxramas V and Z patches (mandatory); J or C and U optional
Verify official N-Addon Collection package and install NCore plus selected addons
Configure enUS realmlist using the pinned Naxxramas realm
Run post-install validation, preserve manifest/backups and offer reversible uninstall
note: This is a blocked design manifest, not a working complete-client downloader. A private GitHub repository and a checksum alone do not establish permission to redistribute game assets.
